project_naming.policy: LBW and YBW are names/identifiers, not combustion-mode labels. Never infer physical meaning from the repository name.

teacher_direction.primary_instruction: Build the one-dimensional ramjet/scramjet model first using the teacher-provided CFD formulas and Cao Ruifeng references; the teacher described this as a second, more accurate scheme.
teacher_direction.target_model_family: unsteady quasi-one-dimensional conservative CFD model for a dual-mode/scramjet combustor
primary_reference_set: Teacher-provided photographed Chapter 11: 双模态冲压燃烧室一维数值模拟
曹瑞峰：面向控制的超燃冲压发动机一维建模研究

wall_heat_transfer_source.note: The solver accepts explicit d(delta q)/dx. The photographed Eq.11.26 empirical-to-dimensional mapping remains source-gated and is not guessed.

steger_warming_fvs.note: The literal closed form is not used as the production variable-thermochemistry flux because it does not reconstruct the current absolute-energy Euler flux and no authoritative correction was found.

cfl_time_step.note: Project exposes a general CFL control and teacher-path production cases use cfl=0.5 unless a case-specific value is documented.

teacher_relative_density_convergence_met.policy: Use Eq.11.46 as the teacher compatibility stopping gate and retain the normalized semi-discrete residual as an independent diagnostic without inventing a source threshold.

near_sonic_eigenvalue_smoothing.note: Formula is transcribed, but no numerical epsilon policy is source-frozen. Do not guess epsilon.

temperature_and_composition_dependent_th.reference: Teacher Chapter 11 Eqs. 11.30-11.35 and Cao references
temperature_and_composition_dependent_th.note: Piecewise source-backed thermochemistry, mixture properties, bounded e-to-T recovery, and per-cell variable-composition state conversion are implemented. C10H22 remains source-gated.

teacher_empirical_wall_heat_closure.note: The exact conversion from the photographed empirical correlation to solver d(delta q)/dx has not been uniquely frozen.

chemical_energy_bookkeeping_consistency.note: Chemical energy is carried through composition-dependent absolute species energy on the teacher variable-thermochemistry path; the direct Qdot interface remains a separate reduced-order surrogate.

cao_case2_formal_reproduction.note: Exact A(x), prescribed Yi(x) spatial information, and original fuel/source spatial convention remain required.
